scope: one GET per exact files.pythonhosted.org wheel URL; no index, sidecars, sdist, install or execution; fresh owner approval and verified collector required
storage: fresh runner-owned temporary directory, exclusive create, never unpack or commit wheel bytes; close and discard on settlement; no owner data
inspection_requirements: Exact byte count and SHA256 before ZIP parsing; no extract/import/execute

Reject duplicate/case-colliding names, path traversal, absolute paths, symlink/special file members, encrypted entries, unsupported compression or bounded size violations; stream read with observed expansion caps

Require single expected dist-info identity, exact METADATA digest equal verified sidecar, WHEEL tags matching filename, validate RECORD membership and per-member hashes/sizes; reject unsupported/missing evidence rather than silently omit

Inventory declared License-File paths, legacy license/notice/copying candidates and bundled/native components; record safe relative identities, hashes, sizes and declaration context; do not claim legal approval from file presence
Retain independently verifiable receipts including failures, per-request exact URL/count/bytes/digests, no secret material; any missing notice or unknown redistribution remains BLOCKED
Separate review of archive inspection implementation and notice evidence persistence before requesting actual wheel acquisition; no automatic reattempt
